title: Imagination - the difference between humans and animals?
html:
Welcome to this week's MondayMotivator.

Happy Monday!

Gee, I'm chipper this morning. No idea why, but Spring having sprung and an early start might have something to do with it.

Richard Koch once wrote about imagination being the difference between humans and animals. Now I'm not exactly sure animals don't imagine, as dogs certainly appear to dream a lot. But, one thing he wrote really appealed to me – imagination is a mental muscle, one that needs to be used to develop it, one that can be trained and expanded, both in quality and quantity.

Imagination keeps you awake at night and fired up in the morning. It really does have that effect on you. However it needs to be used, or like everything left to stand, it will waste away.

This week, imagine something awesome. A holiday. A challenge. A loved one. A new car. Keep imagining it until it's clear and vibrant. Doing so will make you feel great. Even just thinking about it will change your mood.

Try it now and have a great week.

Glenn 'Positivity Personified' Edley
